newsitem.title: USA: June T-bond futures off full point, hit 107-15/32.
newsitem.headline: June T-bond futures off full point, hit 107-15/32.

text.p: June U.S. Treasury bond futures at the Chicago Board of Trade were down a full point at 107-15/32.
The contract ticked below 107-16/32, the low from September 25, 1996, floor brokers said.

The selloff followed stronger than expected U.S. economic data, including a 9.0-percent jump in February existing home sales. Technical selling contributed to the slide, which occurred ahead of Thursday's early pre-holiday futures close.

The pullback shoved June T-bond futures below other critical supports such as 108-09/32, roughly the seven-percent cash yield equivalent, floor brokers said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
